description: Patricia Hawkins calls David Chen at First Community Bank to provide a proactive structured update on Regional Auto Group's financial position and the three-location consolidation — not to request credit, but to build a warm relationship before she may need credit flexibility. She frames it as transparency from a long-standing business account holder: reduced debt load post-closure, EV certification investment, community partnership with the Millfield Auto Tech Pipeline. The goal is to raise trust before it becomes a transactional necessity.
